issues: Only the 2025-26 Program of Studies is linked, even though 2026-27 is underway (the Counseling page does have a 2026-27 School Profile). PDF is a Word export created 2025-02-12; Edlio upload path dated 01/28/26 ('with updated cover'). 56 pages, full descriptions by department (Art, Music, English, Foreign Languages, Global Citizenship, Health, PE, Math, Science, Technology), plus graduation requirements and policies. Graduation requirements also appear as text on the Counseling page itself. CDC (Career Development Center) courses are in a separate CDC Program of Studies, not collected. Naviance is used (sign-in). Note mauhs.org is a Moodle, not the official site.
